MX-17
MANUAL TRANSAXLE {C56) - MANUAL TRANSAXLE ASSEMBLY
17. REMOVE REAR BEARING RETAINER
Remove the 5 bolts and rear bearing retainer.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BONO 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 27 N-m (280 kgf.cm, 20 ft-lbf)
18. REMOVE BEARING SNAP RING
Using a snap ring expander, remove the 2 snap rings.
HINT:
If it is difficult to remove and install the snap rings, pull up the
shafts.
19. REMOVE REVERSE IDLER GEAR SHAFT LOCK BOLT
AND GASKET
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 29 N•m (300 kgt-cm, 22 ft,lbf)
20. REMOVE SNAP RING FROM NO. 2 SHIFT FORK
SHAFT
Using 2 screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the snap ring.
21. REMOVE STRAIGHT SCREW PLUG, SEAT, SPRING
AND BALL
(a) Using a hexagon wrench, remove the 3 straight screw
plugs.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 25 N-m (250 kgf.cm, 18 ft•lbf)
(b) Using a magnetic finger, remove the 3 seats, springs and
ba!ls.
22. REMOVE LOCK BALL ASSEMBLY
Using a hexagon wrench, remove the lock ball assembly.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833--00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 39 N-m (400 kgf.cm, 29 ft.Jbf}
